headline: Executive order sets the order of officials who would lead the Department of Housing and Urban Development if top leaders are unavailable.
what_it_does: This order lists which officials at the Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) would take over the Secretary's duties if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or cannot do the job. No summary was provided, so the specific positions and order are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Certain officials are named, in a set order, to act as Secretary if needed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 18, 2001; the specific effective date is not stated in the available information.
